description: Rank supported cities by composite quality-of-life score across five weighted dimensions (financial, healthcare, vacation, childcare, safety_net). Returns top N (default 10), with filters for country, countries, region (europe/asia/north_america/south_america/oceania), has_universal_healthcare, include_cities, and exclude_cities. Use this to shortlist across many cities; for a head-to-head between two named cities use compare_cities. The same scenario is applied to every city so scores are directly comparable (default: single person, 2BR rent, $100k USD-equivalent gross). Read-only, no side effects; returns a text summary plus structured JSON.

filter.description: Restrict which cities are ranked, by country, region, universal-healthcare flag, or explicit include/exclude slug lists. Omit to rank all supported cities.

country.description: Restrict to one country (case-insensitive match against city_data.country, e.g. "Germany", "USA", "United Kingdom").

exclude_cities.description: Skip these specific city slugs from the result.

has_universal_healthcare.description: If true, only return cities with universal healthcare; if false, only without.

include_cities.description: Restrict to a specific set of city slugs. Combined with other filters via intersection.

scenario.description: Override the default ranking scenario. The same scenario is applied to every city so scores are comparable.

gross_salary_usd.description: USD-equivalent salary to model in each city (converts to local currency). Default 100000.

weights.description: Override the composite-score weights. Defaults: financial 30, healthcare 20, vacation 15, childcare 15, safety_net 20.

name: rank_cities
title: Rank cities by composite quality score
